content.title: Task-to-Breath Reset | Natural Wipe, Micro-Motion, Renewed Exit
content.summary: Lock one original clearly adult subject with at least three identity anchors. Begin with one ordinary tactile task and show its completion. Use one natural foreground object, doorway or architectural edge to transition into a separate rest geometry. Hold long enough to show exactly one slow breath and at least two micro-responses in hair, clothing, plants or light while the camera performs only a restrained push. After the reset, let the same adult resume movement along an established direction and cross one visible exit threshold.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original subject and complete one ordinary tactile task before rest. + Use one natural foreground or architectural edge to transition into a distinct rest geometry. + Show exactly one slow breath and at least two micro-responses in body or environment. + Restrict camera movement during the breath to one slow push or hold. + After rest, resume the same adult's movement and cross a visible exit threshold.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one original clearly adult night baker with copper hair clip, navy apron and white sleeve stripe closing and tying one flour sack in a warm service corridor; complete the tactile knot. The adult sits on a stone ledge with copper clip, navy apron and sleeve stripe unchanged. Establish herbs, hanging cloth and one service gate before becoming still. The same adult stands, resumes left-to-right movement and crosses the established service gate carrying the tied flour sack tag; no source woman, sheet, bicycle, bench, ferns, brick gate or exact composition.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult subject with at least three identity anchors. Begin with one ordinary tactile task and show its completion. Use one natural foreground object, doorway or architectural edge to transition into a separate rest geometry. Hold long enough to show exactly one slow breath and at least two micro-responses in hair, clothing, plants or light while the camera performs only a restrained push. After the reset, let the same adult resume movement along an established direction and cross one visible exit threshold. The reusable mechanism is task completion, natural wipe, measured breathing reset, environmental micro-response and resumed exit—not the source woman, sheet, bicycle, bench, ferns, gate, clothing, exact camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original subject and complete one ordinary tactile task before rest.
invariants.purpose: Gives stillness a before-state and purpose.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening directly on a bench becomes a generic portrait.

invariants.rule: Use one natural foreground or architectural edge to transition into a distinct rest geometry.
invariants.purpose: Connects active and quiet states without arbitrary cutting.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random dissolve loses spatial intention.

invariants.rule: Show exactly one slow breath and at least two micro-responses in body or environment.
invariants.purpose: Makes internal reset visible without melodrama.
invariants.ablation_failure: No micro-response looks frozen; many gestures overplay the moment.

invariants.rule: Restrict camera movement during the breath to one slow push or hold.
After rest, resume the same adult's movement and cross a visible exit threshold.
invariants.purpose: Proves renewal rather than terminal stillness.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on the bench leaves no change in agency.
